verdict.rationale: Vapi documents a first-party compliance mode for the organization that lets you 'control how call recordings and logs are stored', alongside a HIPAA toggle. That is real but org-level control over recording storage, not explicit per-call recording on/off or configurable retention periods. missing for 10: documented per-call recording enable/disable, explicit configurable retention windows or deletion policies, consent/disclosure prompt features tied to recording, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention

citations.quote: Enable organization-wide compliance mode, use approved LLM, voice, and transcriber providers, and control how call recordings and logs are stored.
HIPAA compliance can be ensured by turning on HIPAA compliance in the Dashboard.
